answer: Histories are stored in beacon, checked in glacier, and meadow makes public each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 4 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 6 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
